entries.msgstr: Allows a series of shells to be fired from the magazine one by one, with each round reloading automatically over time.
Allows a series of shells to be fired from the magazine one by one, with each round reloading automatically over time. Provides a bonus to the speed of loading of the next shell during reload.
Fires rapid bursts of shells to deliver high damage in a short time, at the cost of penetration and accuracy. Most effective in close-quarters combat.
Fires star shells, causing maximum damage within 50 m. The shells' damage decreases over distance, making them most effective in close combat.
A unique cooling system that allows for double aiming: waiting after reloading allows the gun to fire more accurately. The improved accuracy is shown by a second, smaller aiming circle.
A double gun system with the ability to fire both barrels separately or simultaneously. Double shots cause high burst damage, but come with a longer reload.
Allows the vehicle's hull to change elevation angles, offering opportunities for fire from more positions in battle. Activation depends on various conditions.
Changes the position of additional wheels to significantly increase speed, but at the cost of maneuverability. Best used to traverse long distances and for rush attacks.

Allows a series of shells to be fired from the magazine before requiring a full reload. Delivers high burst damage, but leaves the vehicle vulnerable while reloading. Can only reload the entire magazine at once.

The gun can fire continuously without the need for reload. Each shot generates heat: the higher its temperature, the more some of its parameters change. Continuous firing will cause the gun to overheat, preventing further firing until it cools down.
Increase engine power and top speed for rapid movement across the battlefield. When activated, jet boosters reduce maneuverability and cannot be disabled manually.

The vehicle's gun has special devices that allow some shell parameters to be modified before firing. Parameters for different shells vary based on the selected mode, and each mode lets you quickly adapt to different combat situations.
When activated, this special mode increases and/or changes certain battle parameters. Best activated when in position and ready to engage the enemy.
Stuns enemy vehicles within a certain blast radius, even without a direct hit, briefly worsening their mobility, accuracy, and reload time. Stunned enemies are marked with a stun indicator.
Allows the vehicle to move at reduced speed when the main track is destroyed. Losing an additional outer track reduces mobility further, but the vehicle can still turn and move.
Allows the vehicle to travel significantly faster while considerably decreasing gun handling parameters.
When activated, this special mode offers double damage and increases and/or changes certain battle parameters. Best used in close-range encounters.

By remaining stationary or moving slowly, you build accuracy levels to improve your next shot's precision.
At the highest accuracy level, you gain decent gun handling, with reduced dispersion even during movement or turret/hull traverse.

The mechanism instantly reduces shell reload to a short fixed time. Each use consumes one charge per shell, and charges replenish over time—faster when the clip is full. A set number of charges is available at the start of battle.

This vehicle is equipped with a rocket launcher mounted in the gun mantlet. Activate the ability to switch to the secondary weapon aiming sight, and then launch an unguided HE rocket with the fire button.

Every time you hit an enemy with a shell, you gain a reload efficiency level, temporarily boosting your gun's reload speed. Levels accumulate with each hit. 
Destroying an enemy vehicle with a shell grants additional reload efficiency levels.
This vehicle's External Ammunition Supply Module allows it to fire powerful high-charge unitary rounds that cause increased damage. While active, the module also reduces mobility and fire rate.

If your gun is loaded, you can start heating your next shot for increased damage—the higher the heat level, the greater the effect.
At maximum heat, you have several seconds to fire—if you do not, you will be temporarily unable to shoot.
Landing two armor-penetrating hits on enemy vehicles triggers Burst mode, loading a burst-fire cassette that lets you unleash two shells in quick succession with your next shot for massive damage.

The Pneumatic Gyro-Stabilizer grants maximum stabilization during movement, hull traverse, and turret traverse, allowing for more accurate firing, as well as rapid response to sudden threats and effective engagement from cover.

The system automatically begins loading a new cassette when one shell remains in the current one, keeping you ready to engage. You can still fire the final shell during this process, but doing so adds several seconds to the remaining reload time.

The system keeps the gun cooled, allowing for highly accurate firing. The gun heats up when fired, but begins cooling down and returns to improved parameters during reload. The higher its temperature, the more some of its parameters change.

Drawing on design experience from earlier models, this vehicle is specially configured for deadly ramming attacks. Structural reinforcements allow it to deal more damage when ramming enemy vehicles, giving an upper hand in close-quarters encounters.
This vehicle's gun can fire early: single-charge shots, fired during reload, have reduced effectiveness, while regular full-charge shots fired after reloading have optimal ballistic parameters.

The gun can fire continuously without the need for reload. Each shot generates heat: the higher its temperature, the more some of its parameters change. Continuous firing will cause the gun to overheat, preventing further firing until it cools down.

Remain stationary or move slowly to build preheat, increasing your next shot’s damage and accuracy. At maximum preheat, penetrating an enemy with fewer HP than your average damage causes an ammo rack explosion, destroying the vehicle.

This mode turns your vehicle into a fortified gun platform, granting superior accuracy and faster reload time. In exchange for this enhanced firepower, vehicle mobility—forward/reverse speed and vertical/horizontal traverse—is severely limited.

This mode provides a significant boost to engine power and top forward speed. The longer you drive forward, the more speed builds, allowing you to surge across the battlefield and cover large distances with ease.

The system accumulates a charge over time, with a higher charge granting more bonus damage. The charge is capped by a limiter, which can be disabled for an even greater damage bonus at the cost of reduced gun handling.

Activate the Liquid Fuel Boosters at any time for a burst of speed when you need it most. The boosters heat up and must cool down before they can be reused, while exceeding the critical heat level will temporarily disable them completely.

When you hit a visible enemy vehicle with a shell, the fuze setter on the next shell is adjusted. If the initial shot penetrated enemy armor, the next shot's damage is increased. If it did not, the next shot's penetration is increased.

The vehicle's gun has special devices that allow some shell parameters to be modified before firing. Parameters for different shells vary based on the selected mode, and each mode lets you quickly adapt to different combat situations.

When activated, the device scans a sector in front of your vehicle, revealing concealed targets before a cooldown. If it reveals an unspotted enemy, you also immediately become spotted. You can manually stop the scan after a short delay.

Solid-fuel thrusters that boost acceleration, mobility, and maneuverability for several seconds. The left and right thrusters can work independently of each other for faster hull traverse, and do not restrict reverse capability.

Depending on the active mode and charge level, the vehicle can activate one of two abilities: 
Ion-Discharge Afterburner: Increases engine power and speed. 
Coincidence Electromechanical Sight: Reduces dispersion and reload time and improves accuracy.

This module keeps you in the fight by letting you interrupt reload at any time if at least one shell is loaded. Press the hotkey to stop reloading, fire after a short delay, then resume reload manually or let the clip auto-reload when empty.
Pressing the activation button fires your vehicle's auxiliary weapons at the target. This additional firepower comes with its own reload cycle, independent of the main gun.

Your next shot applies an effect based on the enemy's spotting status. Hitting a spotted enemy will mark them—they will remain spotted longer and receive more damage. Hitting an unspotted enemy will highlight their location with a special marker.
Offers double damage and improved stabilization at the cost of mobility, accuracy, turret traverse speed, and aiming time. Best used in close combat.

This mechanical modification significantly boosts the vehicle's acceleration, engine power, and top forward and reverse speed for a short time, allowing you to react quickly to enemy attacks and catch opponents off guard with dynamic maneuvers.

Remaining stationary or moving below a certain speed allows your vehicle to calibrate its Analog Ballistic Computing Device and build accuracy levels, increasing the accuracy of your next shot. If you exceed the speed limit, your progress in building accuracy levels will be paused until you slow down. At the highest accuracy level, your vehicle gains decent gun stabilization, with reduced dispersion from movement or turret/hull rotation. The effect is removed upon firing.

This vehicle is equipped with a rocket launcher mounted in the gun mantlet. Activate the ability to switch to the secondary weapon aiming sight, and then launch an unguided HE rocket with the fire button.

Every time you hit a visible enemy with a shell, you gain a reload efficiency level, temporarily boosting your gun's reload speed. Levels accumulate with each hit, and destroying an enemy vehicle with a shell grants additional reload efficiency levels.
This vehicle's External Ammunition Supply Module allows it to fire powerful high-charge unitary rounds that cause increased damage. While active, the module also reduces mobility and fire rate.

If your gun is loaded, you can start to heat your next shot. The higher the heat level you reach, the greater the bonus to average damage will be. During the heating process, you cannot change shells. When you reach maximum heat level, a countdown begins. If you do not fire before it ends, you will be unable to shoot for several seconds.
Scoring two armor-penetrating hits on enemy vehicles activates Burst mode, loading a burst-fire cassette that allows two shells to be fired in quick succession with the next shot.
The Pneumatic Gyro-Stabilizer grants maximum stabilization during hull and turret traverse for a short time, allowing for more accurate firing on the move and quick reaction to sudden threats.

The system automatically starts loading a new cassette when one shell remains in the current one. Firing the final shell while the new cassette is being loaded adds several seconds to the remaining reload time. Pressing the Reload Shell Container hotkey discards all remaining shells except the last one. Press the hotkey twice to reset a fully loaded cassette.

The system keeps the gun cooled, allowing for highly accurate firing. The gun heats up when fired, but begins cooling down and returns to improved parameters during reload. The higher its temperature, the more some of its parameters change.
This vehicle is specially configured for ramming attacks, with a series of design modifications that help it inflict more damage when ramming enemy vehicles.
This vehicle's gun can fire early: single-charge shots, fired during reload, have reduced effectiveness, while regular full-charge shots fired after reloading have optimal ballistic parameters.

The gun can fire continuously without the need for reload. Each shot generates heat: the higher its temperature, the more some of its parameters change. Continuous firing will cause the gun to overheat, preventing further firing until it cools down.

Remaining stationary or moving below a certain speed generates preheat, which increases the average damage and accuracy of your next shot. Exceeding the speed limit gradually reduces the bonus, while firing or changing shells instantly resets it. At maximum preheat level, penetrating the armor of an enemy vehicle with fewer hit points than your average damage—including your accumulated preheat bonus—will cause its ammo rack to explode, instantly destroying the vehicle.

In this mode, gun accuracy, reload speed, and elevation/depression angles are drastically increased, but mobility (forward/reverse speed and vertical/horizontal traverse speed) is severely limited. Percentage values are given for comparison with Siege mode.
Direct Drive mode provides a significant boost to engine power and top forward speed. The longer you drive forward, the more speed builds, allowing you to traverse the battlefield with ease.

Over time, the system automatically accumulates a charge, which is partially consumed to boost damage when firing. The higher the charge, the greater the bonus damage. By default, the system only stores the charge up to a certain limit. Disabling the limit lets it accumulate an even higher charge, granting a much greater damage bonus but reducing gun handling.

The Liquid Fuel Boosters grant a burst of engine power, allowing you to gain a positional advantage on the battlefield—but limiting your vehicle's reverse and traverse speed. They can be toggled on or off at any time, except after reaching the reactivation limit. The boosters heat up while active and become unavailable until cooled down, meaning they cannot be used nonstop—while exceeding the critical heat level will temporarily disable them completely. Plan your moves carefully to avoid being caught off guard.

Upon hitting a visible enemy vehicle with a shell, the fuze setter on the next shell is adjusted. If the initial shot penetrated enemy armor, the next shot's damage is increased. If it did not, the next shot's penetration is increased.
The vehicle's gun has special devices that allow some shell parameters to be modified before firing. The loadout shows which parameters will be affected by switching between firing modes.

An advanced optics device increases your view range and enhances detection of moving and foliage-hidden vehicles. When activated, it scans a narrow sector in front of your vehicle, revealing concealed targets before a cooldown period. If it reveals an unspotted enemy, you also immediately become spotted. You can manually stop the scan after a short delay.

Solid-fuel thrusters that improve vehicle acceleration, mobility, and maneuverability for several seconds. Unlike regular jet boosters, the left and right thrusters can work independently of each other for faster hull traverse, and do not restrict reverse capability. They can be used multiple times per battle, but require a cooldown before reactivation.

Depending on the active mode and charge level, the vehicle can activate one of two abilities: Ion-Discharge Afterburner or Coincidence Electromechanical Sight.
Ion-Discharge Afterburner temporarily increases engine power, top forward speed, and reverse speed. Coincidence Electromechanical Sight temporarily improves accuracy and reduces reload time.

The External Ammunition Supply Module allows you to interrupt reload and start firing at any time, as long as you still have one shell loaded. During reload, the module locks the vehicle's turret and external ammo pods, temporarily preventing you from aiming or firing unless you interrupt it.
This vehicle is equipped with a set of auxiliary weapons whose reload cycle is separate from the main gun, allowing you to cause additional damage in key moments.

The Laser Target Designator adds a special effect to your next shot, applied to any enemy you hit. The effect varies depending on whether the enemy was spotted at the moment of impact. Hitting a spotted enemy vehicle will mark it, extending the time it remains spotted and increasing the damage it receives from shells, while hitting an unspotted enemy vehicle will highlight its location with a special marker.
Offers double damage and improved stabilization at the cost of mobility, accuracy, turret traverse speed, and aiming time. Best used in close combat.

This mechanical modification significantly boosts the vehicle's acceleration, engine power, and top forward and reverse speed for a short time, allowing you to react quickly to enemy attacks and catch opponents off guard with dynamic maneuvers. Maintaining a high movement speed accelerates the mechanic's cooldown.
All values shown are the maximum possible for the vehicle. Equipment, directives, and consumables can change these values, but these changes are not reflected here.
